task_description: Implement the GPU Broker integration as a native TS code plugin at extensions/gpu-broker/. Port the GpuBroker state-machine class (idle|agent-active|user-claimed|draining|dormant) with lease model, ghost-claim, snapshot fallback, register 4 GPU tools (gpu.status, gpu.release, gpu.reclaim, gpu.handoff), wire agent-run gate, warmup recalibration, config/reload, and operator surfaces. Tests split into always-runnable (mocked) and GPU-gated (skip-with-reason).

verification.summary: All 54 tests pass across 5 test files (broker: 25, run-gate: 8, degradation: 8, warmup: 4, registration: 9). Tests cover: state machine transitions, lease token integrity, auto-expiry, ghost-claim trigger/release, canAgentRun gate, warmup recalibration, honest degradation with null snapshots, config reload, plugin registration. Full build skipped due to sandbox resource constraints (vitest already resolves and compiles the test graph). Docker build not applicable.
